paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, with each slice representing the proportion of utterances assigned to a specific emotion, as indicated by the percentages shown inside each segment. The chart is divided into six distinct categories, each labeled and colored differently: “Frustration” (light blue, 25.1%), “Neutral” (dark blue, 23.1%), “Happiness” (light blue, 8.1%), “Excitement” (red, 14.1%), “Sadness” (orange, 14.7%), and “Anger” (yellow, 14.9%). The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with “Frustration” being the largest slice and “Happiness” the smallest. Percentages are clearly labeled within each corresponding slice, and no legend or visual emphasis like exploded slices is present.
